variants.name: V1 cdp key acknowledged, edit immediately
variants.description: await CDP ack of a real keystroke in INSERT, then synchronous version check and editor.edit with no intervening await

variants.name: V2 cdp key not awaited, edit immediately
variants.description: send real keystroke without awaiting, synchronous check and editor.edit in the same tick

variants.name: V3 cdp key plus delayed helper 0-300 ms
variants.description: real keystroke sent; the helper answer arrives after 0..300 ms; synchronous check then editor.edit

variants.name: V4 workspace.applyEdit not awaited, edit immediately
variants.description: workspace.applyEdit insertion started without await, synchronous check and editor.edit in the same tick

variants.name: V5 workspace.applyEdit plus delayed helper 0-300 ms
variants.description: workspace.applyEdit started; helper answer after 0..300 ms; synchronous check then editor.edit

variants.name: V6 cdp key (worker thread), extension host busy 3-40 ms, edit immediately
variants.description: real keystroke sent from a worker thread, then the extension host thread is blocked synchronously (the renderer applies the key; its change event waits in the host queue behind the helper answer); synchronous check then editor.edit

variants.name: V7 workspace.applyEdit, extension host busy 3-40 ms, edit immediately
variants.description: workspace.applyEdit started, then the extension host is blocked synchronously while the main thread applies it; synchronous check then editor.edit
